phase: B4 data-quantity research, 927-day rung extension (candidate refinement)
registered_at_source: written while the registered 1.32/2.64 trajectory of the 927-day rung was training and before any 927 score was read
purpose: Fix, before any 927-day score exists, the single condition under which the 927-day trajectory is extended from 2.64 to 3.96 effective epochs, so the extension cannot be chosen after seeing the numbers.
extension_rule: 927 日轨迹是否从 2.64 续到 3.96，当且仅当 927 日的种子配对 (2.64 − 1.32) RankIC 差值为正、且其 5 交易日移动块 bootstrap 95% 区间不含零时触发；否则停在 2.64，不续训。
evidence_caliber: 与 240→441 那次完全相同——同 5 个审计窗、104 个交易日、eval-v2、按交易日配对。
not_a_dose_claim: 剂量结论只用已注册的 (1.32, 2.64) 对；3.96 是候选精化，不得用于"更多数据更好"的声明。
homogeneity: 一旦触发，三个种子全部续到 3.96，不允许混合长度的 blend。
cost_cap: 3 种子 × 305,405 步增量，wall 上限 3 h。
no_threshold_change: 晋升阈值一个字都不改。

appended_point.name: scaling-3.96
appended_point.role: candidate refinement only: the extension is triggered by the pre-registered paired 2.64-vs-1.32 rule, and 3.96 never supports a dose claim

plan_shape.unchanged: recipe_config, recipe_sha256, both registered budget points, exposure, resume, cloud and evaluation_scope are byte-identical to the registered two-point plans
plan_shape.mechanism: run_training_trajectory.py --resume-from <finished 2.64 run> continues from that run's last checkpoint; the 1.32 and 2.64 points are not retrained
plan_shape.derived_reference: left as registered: it documents the two registered magnitudes; the driver re-derives every point from the pool actually built

trigger_reading.paired_quantity: per-seed RankIC difference (2.64 - 1.32) at the registered points, then the seed mean
trigger_reading.interval: 5-day moving-block bootstrap 95% interval, 4000 draws, paired by trading day (the registered 240->441 estimator)
trigger_reading.windows: the same five audit windows and 104 paired trading days as the 240->441 comparison
trigger_reading.metric: eval-v2 RankIC, paired by trading day
trigger_reading.trigger: seed-paired difference positive AND the 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise the rung stops at 2.64

prefix_guard.rule: the source run's trained points must be the head of the extension plan's points (run_training_trajectory.resume_position)

prohibitions: no extension when the registered trigger does not fire
no change to any promotion threshold, secondary line, net5 limit or cost scenario
no reading of the sealed interval
no retraining of the 1.32 or 2.64 points
